title: Blending two consonants together: fr, st and mp
examples: Why do I miss a letter in stop?

explain.say: Look at the word frog on the board. It starts with two consonants side by side. Vowels are a, e, i, o and u. All the other letters are consonants. In frog, you hear both f and r.

draw.text: Blending two consonants together: fr, st and mp

explain.say: Look at the first letter, f. It makes the first sound in fish. You can make this sound long: fff. Keep the sound going into the next one.
Now look at r. It makes the first sound in rabbit. Slide from the f sound into the r sound. Tap 4 times for 4 sounds. Then blend them to read frog.
Look at the word stop. It starts with s and t together. Say a long s, then a short t. You hear both sounds. Tap 4 times and blend to read stop.
Two consonants can come at the end too. Look at the word jump. It ends with m and p. Hum the m, then add a short p. Today, find 3 words that start with st.

faq.a: Consonants are all the letters that are not vowels. The vowels are a, e, i, o and u, so b, c, d, f, g and the rest are consonants.
It is two or three consonants side by side. You still hear each sound, like s and t in stop, or f and r in frog.

faq.q: Why do I miss a sound in words like frog?
faq.a: The two sounds come quickly, one after the other. It is easy to miss one. Tap one finger for each sound, so you hear both.
asks: Why do I read fog instead of frog?

faq.q: How do I read the end of jump?
faq.a: Hum the m sound, then say a short p sound. You hear both. Tap them on two fingers.
There are many. Some start words, like bl, cr, sp and tr. Some end words, like nd, st and lt. A teacher or grown-up can help you make a blend wall.

facts: The word frog has four letters and four sounds.
In a consonant blend, like st in stop, you can hear the sound of each letter.

quiz.say: How many sounds are in the word stop?
quiz.show: 🛑 How many sounds are in stop?
quiz.why: Stop has 4 sounds. You hear both the s and the t.

wrong.0: The s and the t are 2 separate sounds, so there is 1 more.
wrong.2: Stop has 4 letters, and each letter makes 1 sound.

quiz.say: Which word starts with 2 consonant sounds?
quiz.why: Frog starts with f and r. You hear both sounds before the o.

wrong.0: Fog starts with 1 consonant, f, then the vowel o.
wrong.1: Egg starts with the vowel e.
